items.q: Brent Sparks and Eppie. When Brent left, we only kept Eppie, until we got Pips.

ctx.x: You mean Brent Sparks and Eppie?
Brent Sparks and Eppie. When Brent left, we only kept Eppie, until we got Pips.
How were you going to work with two tuba players; that's pretty hard to work that out.
